items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: Johnny come on over there and... Fitted in all right with us. Start the playin'. We should fight every night.

ctx.x: had, uh, Johnny Brown was playing. Johnny Dodge used to work for Johnny Brown. Mm-hmm. Johnny Brown had a furniture wagon, you know? Mm-hmm. Then Johnny Brown used to be around those auctions, you know, around those prawn lids, you know? Mm-hmm. All in there. Yeah. And, uh, they used to haul them. Different items, you know, that people buy furniture and stuff, you know? And things like that. Then they'd get to deliver them. Johnny used to work on the, work for him.
